recommendations.title: Engineering Support Sprint
recommendations.summary: A focused technical review for a defined asset, system, proposal, design question, or facility issue.
bestFor: A decision needs a clear technical basis before cost, schedule, or scope moves forward.
An owner, operator, or project team needs a practical second opinion.
A technical issue needs to be explained clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
recommendations.cta: Email the technical question and the date it has to be settled, and attach whatever drawings, photos, or readings you already have.

recommendations.title: Project Controls Reset
recommendations.summary: A structured review of project records, open issues, decisions, RFIs, submittals, risks, and stakeholder reporting.
bestFor: A project is active but the next actions are unclear.
Risks, RFIs, decisions, or submittals are scattered across too many places.
An owner needs a plain-language status view without losing technical detail.
recommendations.cta: Email the current blocker and who is waiting on it, with a schedule snapshot or issue log if one exists.

recommendations.title: Energy Opportunity Scan
recommendations.summary: A practical review of utility data, operating schedules, BAS trends, demand patterns, and obvious energy-waste signals.
bestFor: Utility costs are rising and the cause is unclear.
Energy data exists but is not yet tied to specific actions.
Operators need help prioritizing what to verify first.
recommendations.cta: Email a recent bill or trend along with the operating limits you cannot break, and Techniek will name the first dataset worth reviewing.

notAllowed: FCI, CUI, export-controlled technical data, credentials, or contract-controlled records
Google Drive documents unless explicitly approved for public use
